description: This PHP source file defines a 'LeaveEventSubscriber' class that subscribes to leave-related events in an HR management system, handles these events, and queues email notifications accordingly.

classes.name: LeaveEventSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to leave events and handles email notification logic based on those events.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping leave events to handler methods.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Initializes and returns the EmailService instance, singleton pattern.

methods.name: onAllocateEvent
methods.description: Handles leave allocation events, determines email template, and queues notifications.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles leave status change events (approve, cancel, reject), and queues notifications accordingly.
